name: The Sacred Ponds
description: A creature that takes a short rest within the life-infused waters of these ponds gains special benefits. • When expending hit dice to regain hit points, it regains twice the number of hit points. Additionally, the restorative waters cleanse the creature of any natural diseases. • The waters also imbue the creature with vital energy, granting temporary resilience. The next time the creature would gain a level of exhaustion within the following 24 hours, that level is ignored, ending this effect. Taking the water outside of Bak causes it to lose its properties.
